## What it is

The base and the saddle clips for one 1000 mm strip, posed on the helix. Nothing in the assembly is a separate printable. Export the base and the clip.

## Design notes

- Turn 1 is the four base clips, already staggered. Standalone clips land on turns 2 and 4, four each, on the same four angles as the base. That is eight clips.
- A longer strip adds the next even turn (6, then 8) and another four identical clips. Odd turns stay empty on purpose.
- The assembly sliders drive both parts together. A clip printed at a different `coil_diameter` than the base will not sit on the helix.

## Don't

- Don't export the assembly as one STL. The clips print on their ends; the base prints on its ring. Those are different orientations.
- Don't add a clip to turn 3 to "fill the gap". Turn 3 is the spacer. It is supposed to be bare tube.
